  row_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (source_id, item_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES vmodel_semantic_items (item_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vmodel_source_target_edges (
  edge_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

  disposition TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
  row_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (source_id, target_type, target_ref),
  FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES vmodel_sources (source_id),
  CHECK (disposition IN ('adopt', 'merge', 'reference', 'defer', 'not_applicable', 'reject')),
  CHECK (target_type IN ('plan_alias', 'artifact_family', 'artifact_path', 'target_slot'))
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vmodel_item_target_edges (
  edge_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_kind TEXT,
  target_ref TEXT,
  plan_id TEXT,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (item_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES vmodel_semantic_items (item_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES plan_registry (plan_id),
  CHECK (target_status IN ('pending_review', 'adopt', 'merge', 'reference', 'defer', 'not_applicable', 'reject')),
  CHECK ((target_kind IS NULL) OR (target_kind IN ('plan_alias', 'artifact_family', 'artifact_path', 'target_slot'))),
  CHECK (((target_status = 'pending_review') AND (target_kind IS NULL) AND (target_ref IS NULL)) OR ((target_status IN ('adopt', 'merge', 'reference', 'defer')) AND (target_kind IS NOT NULL) AND (target_ref IS NOT NULL)) OR (target_status IN ('not_applicable', 'reject'))),
  CHECK ((NOT (target_status = 'defer')) OR (plan_id IS NOT NULL))
)

  CHECK (profile_axis IN ('size', 'product')),

  profile_id TEXT,
  target_kind TEXT,
  target_id TEXT,
  scope_status TEXT,
  target_version TEXT,
  defer_reason TEXT,
  enabled INTEGER,
  source_path TEXT,
  plan_id TEXT,
  indexed_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS activation_schedule_reviews (
  activation_schedule_review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  profile_id TEXT,
  plan_id TEXT,
  schedule_entry_id TEXT,
  activation_entry_id TEXT,
  target_kind TEXT,
  target_id TEXT,
  scope_status TEXT,
  enabled INTEGER,
  target_version TEXT,
  defer_reason TEXT,
  current_location TEXT,
  rag TEXT,
  schedule_status TEXT,
  layer TEXT,
  sub_doc TEXT,
  v_pair TEXT,
  source_path TEXT,
  indexed_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_catalog_entries (
  document_catalog_entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  doc_type_id TEXT,
  layer TEXT,
  sub_doc TEXT,
  category TEXT,
  requirement_class TEXT,
  applicability TEXT,
  default_status TEXT,
  source_doc_family TEXT,
  authoring_source_path TEXT,
  projection_table TEXT,
  profile_controlled INTEGER,
  skip_reason_required INTEGER,
  source_path TEXT,
  indexed_at TEXT,
  UNIQUE (doc_type_id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_scale_profile_entries (
  document_scale_profile_entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  doc_type_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  decision TEXT NOT NULL,
  detail_override TEXT NOT NULL,
  status_override TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  required_plan_id TEXT,
  row_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  indexed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (profile_id, doc_type_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES document_scale_profiles (profile_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (doc_type_id) REFERENCES document_catalog_entries (doc_type_id),
  CHECK (decision IN ('adopt', 'conditional', 'skip', 'defer')),
  CHECK (detail_override IN ('lite', 'standard', 'detailed')),
  CHECK (status_override IN ('minimal', 'standard', 'required', 'profile_controlled', 'skipped')),
  CHECK ((NOT (decision = 'defer')) OR (required_plan_id IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_scale_profile_reviews (
  document_scale_profile_review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  profile_id TEXT,
  doc_type_id TEXT,
  document_scale_profile_entry_id TEXT,
  document_catalog_entry_id TEXT,
  decision TEXT,
  detail_override TEXT,
  status_override TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  required_plan_id TEXT,
  catalog_layer TEXT,
  catalog_sub_doc TEXT,
  requirement_class TEXT,
  catalog_default_status TEXT,
  catalog_profile_controlled INTEGER,
  catalog_skip_reason_required INTEGER,
  source_path TEXT,
  indexed_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spec_rag_closure_entries (
